profile.headline: Web Developer | Project Manager | Outsourced IT Professional
profile.jobTitle: Owner | Outsourced IT Professional | Web Developer | Project Manager
profile.summary:
I have over five years of experience as a WordPress Web Developer. I work as an IT consultant, Web Developer, outsourced IT, and so much more at The Techy VA, where I help small businesses with their IT needs.

Previously, I worked at Kalio as an eCommerce Project Manager, assisting clients in improving their eCommerce websites. I usually had 30 - 40 client projects at a time.

positions.title: Owner | Outsourced IT Professional | Web Developer | Project Manager
positions.description:
I’ve been in IT my entire career. After graduating with a degree in Computer Information Technology, I worked as an IT professional for a number of years. When I decided to go out on my own, I wanted the flexibility to take on interesting clients and projects. The Techy VA was born!

I help marketing professionals to be their very best by working behind the scenes:

•	Managing technology projects
•	Developing websites - Web Developer
•	Trouble-shooting 
•	Creating Automations
•	Setting up Email Campaigns

I also help small business owners to manage all elements of their technology; turning challenges into opportunity. I’m their outsourced CTO (Chief Technology Officer)!

I help entrepreneurs grow their businesses and get stuff done!

positions.title: Ecommerce Project Manager
positions.description: Managing multiple site enhancement projects and implementation projects.  Working with clients and team to scope, estimate, create and track timeline to ensure we are on track, reporting and assisting in quality assurance.
